criteria.requirement: Add wtforms.jsondata.JSONFormData implementing getlist, iteration, contains, length and first-value lookup. Snapshot a top-level JSON mapping into standard hyphen form paths: objects recurse, lists use numeric FieldList indices unless the complete path is explicitly listed in multi_values for SelectMultiple. Define None as present empty string, booleans true/false, finite numbers decimal text, strings unchanged; missing keys stay absent and explicit empty multi-value list stays present. Reject hyphen-containing/empty/nonstring keys, path collisions, unsupported objects/nonfinite numbers, excessive depth/value budget and malformed roots. Preserve caller ownership and never auto-treat arbitrary dict formdata or change data/obj semantics. Validate with actual FormField/FieldList/SelectMultiple processing and nested error locations.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
